# Phillip Bösger · Bösger Digital

> Personal site and brand hub of Phillip Bösger, a freelance Polarion ALM expert and AI & full-stack developer (Bösger Digital). Tagline: "More AI, less manual work." Available from 01/2027, remote worldwide, hybrid on request in DACH.

## Work with me

- Dev: custom Polarion extensions (Java, REST, Velocity, workflows) from spec to production, CI/CD with automated release documentation.
- Enablement: hands-on assessments, coaching sprints and AI training for teams using Polarion and AI tools.
- Beyond: full-stack and AI development, custom AI agents, automations, integrations and internal tools.
- Contact: digital@boesger.com · https://calendly.com/phillip-boesger/30min · https://www.linkedin.com/in/phillip-boesger-90691215a/

## Projects

- [AI Enablement Hub](https://boesger.com/work/ai-enablement-hub): structured AI coaching for developers, from 149 EUR (materials access), team package on request
- [Polarion MCP Server](https://boesger.com/work/polarion-mcp): open-source MCP server for the Polarion REST API (MIT)
- [Polarion Docker](https://boesger.com/work/polarion-docker): containerized Polarion ALM setup (open source, MIT)
- [Polarion Code Editor](https://boesger.com/work/polarion-code-editor): Monaco-based file editor inside the Polarion admin
- [Daily Board](https://boesger.com/work/daily-board): local-first iOS app combining Reminders, Calendar, journal and notes

## Brand colors

All colors are CSS custom properties; full reference with HEX and RGB at https://boesger.com/colors.

| Name | HEX | CSS token | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deep Navy | `#000D1C` | `--bg-deep` | Page background |
| Dark Navy | `#001222` | `--bg-base` | Sections and areas |
| Surface Navy | `#062237` | `--bg-surface` | Cards and panels |
| Elevated | `#124061` | `--bg-elevated` | Hover, borders, dividers |
| Cyan Primary | `#01BFFB` | `--accent` | Logo, CTAs, links, icons |
| Cyan Light | `#6BDFF1` | `--accent-light` | Hover, glow, highlights |
| Cyan Deep | `#058FC1` | `--accent-deep` | Active states, gradient end |
| Cyan Muted | `#336D91` | `--accent-muted` | Disabled, subtle UI |
| Cyan Tint | `rgba(1,191,251,0.12)` | `--accent-tint` | Tinted backgrounds and badges |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | `--text-primary` | Headings |
| Ice Blue | `#C0F6FC` | `--text-body` | Body text |
| Muted Blue | `#336D91` | `--text-muted` | Placeholders, labels, meta |
